entities.summary: Vale de Cambra is a city and a municipality in Portugal. The population in 2011 was 22,864, in an area of 147.33 km². It had 21,440 electors in 2006. The city itself has about 4,100 inhabitants and is located in the Vila Chã, Codal e Vila Cova de Perrinho parish. Freguesia de Arada was a freguesia of Portugal in Europe. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
